in_marathi.name: Chandresh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon God's Grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandresh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit words 'Chandra' meaning moon and 'Rish' meaning god. This name represents the grace and blessings of the Moon God.

in_bengali.name: Chandresh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Moon God's Grace
in_bengali.long_meaning: Chandresh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from Sanskrit words 'Chandra' meaning moon and 'Rish' meaning god. This name represents the grace and blessings of the Moon God.
